stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 tag [-a] [-f] [-m <message>] [-l <pattern>] [-d <tagname>]
                 [-n <n>] [--] [<args>...]

Create, list, or delete tags.

Options:
    -a, --annotate
        create an annotated tag
    -f, --force
        replace existing tag
    -m <message>, --message=<message>
        tag message
    -l <pattern>, --list=<pattern>
        list tags matching pattern
    -d <tagname>, --delete=<tagname>
        delete a tag
    -n <n>
        print n lines of tag message
    <args>...
        tag name and optional target
